mapper.insert: insert into TB_TOPUP_ORDER ( store_id, order_id, topup_status, payment_status, esim_corp, esim_iccid, shipping_tel, shipping_name, send_date_time , shipping_mail , topup_usd_price, topup_krw_price, topup_cost_krw, topup_param_json, product_option, token_id ) values ( #{storeId}, #{orderId}, #{topupStatus}, #{paymentStatus}, #{esimCorp}, #{esimIccid}, #{shippingTel}, #{shippingName}, null, #{shippingMail}, #{topupUsdprice}, #{topupKrwprice}, #{topupCostKrw}, #{topupParamJson}, #{productOption}, #{tokenId} )
mapper.select: select * from TB_TOPUP_ORDER where esim_iccid = #{esimIccid} and topup_status = 1 and payment_status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
select * from TB_TOPUP_ORDER where esim_iccid = #{esimIccid} and topup_status = 1 and payment_status = 1
mapper.sql:
where
and t.store_id = #{tab}
AND t.store_id in ()
and t.regist_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDate},' 00:00:00')
and t.regist_dt <= CONCAT(#{endDate},' 23:59:59')
and t.shipping_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{shippingName},'%')
and t.shipping_tel LIKE CONCAT('%',#{shippingTel},'%')
and t.esim_iccid LIKE CONCAT('%',#{esimIccid},'%')
mapper.select:
select t.*, o.product_order_id, CASE WHEN THEN ROUND(CAST(t.topup_krw_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) * #{feeRate}) END AS fee_krw, CASE WHEN AND t.topup_cost_krw IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(t.topup_krw_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) - t.topup_cost_krw - ROUND(CAST(t.topup_krw_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) * #{feeRate}) END AS profit_krw from TB_TOPUP_ORDER t LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORDER o ON o.id = t.order_id
order by t.id desc

select COUNT(1) as cnt, IFNULL(SUM(CAST(t.topup_krw_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) as salesSum, IFNULL(SUM(t.topup_cost_krw),0) as costSum, IFNULL(SUM(ROUND(CAST(t.topup_krw_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) * #{feeRate})),0) as feeSum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.topup_cost_krw IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(t.topup_krw_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) - t.topup_cost_krw - ROUND(CAST(t.topup_krw_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) * #{feeRate}) END),0) as profitSum from TB_TOPUP_ORDER t
